'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**The [[United Nations]] orders its staff to evacuate from [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]], as clashes between [[Gang war in Haiti|armed gangs]], [[Haitian National Police|police]], and civilian vigilantes escalate in the city. Nonprofit organization [[Food for the Poor]] also ceases operations in Haiti due to gang disruptions. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/25/un-evacuation-in-haiti-police-assault-stronghold-of-gang-leader-barbecue (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[German economic crisis (2022–present)|German economic crisis]]
**[[Germany]]'s largest [[steelmaking|steelmaker]] conglomerate, [[ThyssenKrupp]], announces plans to [[layoff]] 11,000 workers, including 5,000 in [[Europe]], by 2030. [https://www.dw.com/en/german-steel-giant-thyssenkrupp-to-slash-11000-jobs/a-70880227 (DW)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024–25 Australian region cyclone season]]
**Sixteen people are killed and six others are missing in [[flash flood]]s caused by [[Tropical Low 01U (2024)|Tropical Low 01U]] in [[Sumatra]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-north-sumatra-flash-floods-landslide-df987590034f68545597a2e917fc82e9 (AP)] [https://www.irishexaminer.com/world/arid-41523464.html (''The Irish Examiner'')]
*[[2024 Red Sea tourist boat disaster]]
**Sixteen people are missing and 28 others are rescued after a boat carrying tourists sinks off the coast of [[Marsa Alam]], [[Red Sea Governorate]], [[Egypt]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cm2m7z9xpndo.amp (BBC News)]
*[[Swiftair Flight 5960]]
**One crew member is killed and three others are injured when a [[DHL Aviation|DHL]] [[Boeing 737-400F]] [[cargo plane]] operated by [[Swiftair]] crashes into the ground near a residential building while approaching [[Vilnius Airport]] in [[Lithuania]]. No one on the ground is injured. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/dhl-cargo-plane-crashes-near-vilnius-airport-2024-11-25/ (Reuters)] [https://www.dw.com/en/lithuania-dhl-freight-plane-crashes-near-vilnius-airport/a-70875160 (DW)]
*Nine [[economic migrant|migrants]], including six children, are killed and 39 others are rescued from a [[shipwreck]] off the coast of [[Samos]], [[Greece]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/25/several-migrants-drown-in-shipwreck-off-greek-island-of-samos (Al Jazeera)] [https://tribune.com.pk/story/2511856/nine-including-six-children-die-in-separate-boat-sinkings-in-near-greece (''The Express Tribune'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Afghanistan–Russia relations]]
**[[Secretary of the Security Council of Russia]] [[Sergei Shoigu]] pledges [[Russia]]'s intent to build closer ties with the [[Taliban]] [[Government of Afghanistan]], and states that the [[United States]] should lead rebuilding efforts due to its part in the [[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War in Afghanistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/russia-pledges-broader-afghanistan-ties-says-us-should-help-rebuild-2024-11-26/ (Reuters)]
*Foreign ministers of the [[G7]] nations hold a meeting in [[Fiuggi]] and [[Anagni]], [[Italy]], to discuss [[ceasefire]] efforts between [[Israel]] and [[Lebanon]] as well as the [[International Criminal Court]]'s [[International Criminal Court arrest warrants for Israeli figures|arrest warrants]] for [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] and [[Hamas]] [[Al-Qassam Brigades|military chief]] [[Mohammed Deif]]. [https://www.digitaljournal.com/world/g7-ministers-discuss-ceasefire-efforts-in-mideast/article#ixzz8sdiiSSt (''Digital Journal'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Censorship in Australia]]
**[[Parliament of Australia|Australian Parliament]] vetoes a bill that would authorize the [[Australian Communications and Media Authority]] to implement detailed [[Surveillance|surveillance]] on [[Digital platform (infrastructure)|digital platforms]] and enforce anti-[[Misinformation|misinformation]] punitive measures on them, which opposition politicians condemn as "[[Censorship|censorship laws]]" and a betrayal to [[Democracy|democracy]]. [https://apnews.com/article/australia-misinformation-bill-tech-1625518609bcc407c63c9934b6a2a848 (AP)]
*[[Indictments against Donald Trump]]
**[[United States federal judge|U.S. federal judge]] [[Tanya Chutkan]] of the [[United States District Court for the District of Columbia|District Court for the District of Columbia]] dismisses the two criminal cases by [[Jack Smith (lawyer)|Jack Smith]] against [[President-elect of the United States|President-elect]] [[Donald Trump]], including the [[Federal prosecution of Donald Trump (classified documents case)|classified documents case]] and [[Federal prosecution of Donald Trump (election obstruction case)|the case]] involving [[Attempts to overturn the 2020 United States presidential election|Trump's efforts]] to overturn his defeat to [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] in the [[2020 United States presidential election|2020 presidential election]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/jack-smith-dismiss-charges-trump-d-c-election-case/ (CBS News)] [https://www.politico.com/news/2024/11/25/jack-smith-drops-case-trump-election-00191514 (Politico)]
*Five people are killed in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Saint Andrew Parish, Jamaica|Saint Andrew]], [[Kingston, Jamaica]]. [https://apnews.com/article/jamaica-mass-shooting-five-killed-8b084e634a50230a12678814a30b63ef (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Jubaland presidential election]]
**The [[Jubaland]] House of Representatives re-elects incumbent [[List of presidents of Jubaland|President]] [[Ahmed Madobe]] for the third time amid tensions with the [[Somali federal government]] that resulted in [[Somali National Army|armed forces]] being deployed to [[Kamboni]], [[Badhadhe District]], [[Lower Juba]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.barrons.com/articles/somalia-s-jubaland-leader-at-odds-with-mogadishu-wins-third-term-1b9a5fdd (AFP)] [https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/somalia-ahmed-madobe-romps-to-victory-in-jubaland (Garowe Online)] [https://eastleighvoice.co.ke/somalia/92421/ahmed-madobe-re-elected-as-jubaland-president-for-a-third-term (''The Eastleigh Voice'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Microsoft]] reports widespread outages across [[Microsoft Outlook|Outlook]], [[Microsoft Teams|Teams]], and other [[Microsoft 365|365]] programs. The outages are later resolved during the evening. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/maryroeloffs/2024/11/25/microsoft-outage-outlook-and-teams-restoration-time-unclear-as-company-deploys-fix/ (''Forbes'')] [https://www.cnn.com/2024/11/25/tech/microsofts-outlook-teams-outage/index.html (CNN)]

'''Sports'''
*In [[auto racing]], [[Formula One]] announces that [[General Motors]] will join the grid as a [[List of Formula One constructors|constructor]] under the [[Cadillac Formula One Team|Cadillac Team]] beginning in the [[2026 Formula One World Championship|2026 season]]. [https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/statement-on-general-motors-application-to-join-fia-formula-one-world.69uoRF1uwHwXkr4efkpnhc (Formula 1)] [https://frontofficesports.com/formula-one-will-add-gm-to-grid-as-cadillac-by-2026/ (Front Office Sports)]
*In [[cricket (sport)|cricket]], [[batting (cricket)|batter]] [[Vaibhav Suryavanshi]] becomes the youngest player to sign with the [[Indian Premier League]] at the age of 13. [https://www.dw.com/en/cricket-13-year-old-becomes-youngest-ipl-auction-signing/a-70882497 (DW)] [https://www.hindustantimes.com/cricket/vaibhav-suryavanshi-13-becomes-youngest-player-to-be-bought-at-ipl-auction-sold-to-rr-for-inr-1-10-crore-101732547104362.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
*The [[World Chess Championship 2024]] starts in [[Singapore]], with [[Ding Liren]] winning with black against [[Gukesh Dommaraju]]. [https://www.fide.com/news/3320 (FIDE)]
